annotations.text:
The window currently looks like a different product from the pill — warm paper and a serif, against dark glass and electric blue.

This redesign is the app becoming the pill, grown large. Every value is lifted from Theme.xaml: Georgia at 30/27/17, 14px cards with 22px padding, 9px buttons, the HUD's own glass tokens.

Sample data, and two cards designed ahead of the code.

Calendar and mail are real and working. 'Due this week' and 'This month' are not built — bills would come from the email detection we discussed, and the money figures from Cashew. Designed now so the layout does not have to be redone later.
